text: I called twenty minutes ago about a burst pipe in my basement and nobody's called me back yet! Water is still pouring in.

I'm so sorry to hear that. First, please make sure to shut off your main water valve right away if you haven't already.

Could I please get your address and callback phone number so I can urge our on-call technician to respond immediately?
It's 61 Ashland Ave in Buffalo, and my number is 716-555-0309. Please hurry, my basement is flooding!
